source.title: K/V-Cache Interventions Dissociate Representation Alignment from Persona Expression in Decoder-Only Language Models
source.authors: Yu Sun; Mengyin Lu; Cong Feng; Guangming Lu; Huimin Han

record.file_problem: None; the full paper text is present.
record.tranche_reason: The study measures representation–behavior dissociations under K/V-cache interventions in one checkpoint. It does not test whether independently trained models become more aligned with scale, across seeds, modalities, or other claim versions.
record.gate_note: The reported alignment is between manipulated cache states and source- or target-prompt references within Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. It is not a measurement of convergence between independently trained models. The rows below record the closest related alignment and behavior results, all linked to none of the claim versions.
record.test_reason: The study intervenes on the K/V cache of one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) and measures cosine alignment between manipulated and reference caches within that model, plus persona-marker density and TTR. It compares no independently trained models, seeds, modalities or scales, and maps no representations between models. It does not cite or engage the convergence claim, so even 'discusses' overstates the link. 'cites_only' is the closest enum value; the study effectively neither tests nor uses the claim.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The authors conclude that representation-level similarity (K/V cosine or the L28 V⋆ projection) alone does not predict persona-marker expression or lexical diversity under K/V interventions. Mid-layer (L9–20) replacement uniquely combines target transfer with preserved TTR. A same-token-sequence control shows the representational shift is not solely due to imported token history. Scope is limited to one model, one persona pair and one seed topic.
record.recipe_differences: The study evaluates its own K/V-cache intervention battery; it does not reproduce the methods of the cited representation-convergence sources.
record.method_sensitivity: The results differ by K/V layer band and intervention scope. Marker-density values also shift under stricter matching rules, although the authors report that the main ordering remains.

fits_no_version.finding: In one checkpoint, K/V transplant conditions with comparable V-space alignment (0.94 vs 0.89) or comparable L28 V⋆-gap (+3.96, +3.83, +4.09) give different TTR (0.65, 0.77, 0.39) and different marker density.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Within a fixed model under cache interventions, representation-to-reference similarity does not predict surface behaviour.

fits_no_version.finding: Layer-band K/V replacement gives alignment only in the replaced band (≥0.84 within the band, ≤0.14 off-band), and behaviour differs by band.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Cache-alignment changes from K/V replacement stay local to the intervened layers and do not propagate across layers.

record.problems: The study uses one model, one persona pair, and one seed topic. K/V cosine measurements use one sample per condition; the authors note that the within-band replacement alignment is fixed by construction. Persona behavior is measured with marker density and TTR rather than independent human attribution, and TTR is the only lexical-diversity metric. The authors describe the evidence as limited to their intervention setting.
record.rows_left_out: No additional claim-version findings were found. The same-token-sequence control, interpolation and position-perturbation results, hidden-state V⋆ projections, and activation-channel experiments are not included as rows because they do not test cross-model representation convergence or another listed version.

untested.parts: All: no cross-model, cross-architecture or scale comparison.
All: no cross-model mapping or stitching. The K/V transplant is within one model, between prompts.
All: no cross-model features or circuits.
All: the metric dependence it shows concerns within-model intervention alignment, not cross-model convergence.

record.verdict_notes: The study does not concern representation convergence at all. It references neither original source, so 'discusses' is not apt. All twelve rows correctly carry versions ['none']. The within-band cosine values in r2–r4 are partly fixed by construction.

versions.untested_parts: No comparison of independently trained models, architectures, objectives, data, model scale, or capability.
No vision-language model comparison or paired image-caption representation measurement.
No comparison across random initializations or shared-feature/subspace measurement across independently trained networks.
No mapping, stitching, or interchangeability test between different models' representations.
No comparison of recurring interpretable features or circuits across models.

The study varies K/V intervention configurations and reports more than one representation metric, but does not test convergence between models under different similarity measures, settings, or input distributions.
No test of convergence plateaus or whether shared training data or objectives explain cross-model alignment.
